title: Clinical Outcomes of Steep-Axis One-Handed Phacoemulsification under the Guidance of a Verion Image-Guided System

license.statement: CC BY, version not stated (article <license>: 'open access article distributed under the Creative Commons Attribution License, which permits unrestricted use, distribution, and reproduction in any medium, provided the original work is properly cited')

indication: Age-related cataract with regular corneal astigmatism (total corneal astigmatism above 0.5 D), LOCS III nuclear opalescence of grade 3 or less, normal anterior segment and fundus, no previous intraocular surgery or injury

groups.description: One-handed phacoemulsification through a 2.4 mm clear corneal incision at the steep axis of total corneal astigmatism (Verion-guided), Centurion OZil IP burst mode, monofocal aspheric IOL in the bag; technique chosen by the patient; single surgeon; prospective non-randomized; 104 eyes of 96 patients
Two-handed phacoemulsification through a 2.4 mm steep-axis clear corneal incision plus a 1.0 mm limbal side incision; eye conditions matched; 105 eyes of 96 patients

exclusions.reason: The same table gives absolute ECD for each group; the absolute ECD series is used

exclusions.what: Table 4 p columns; 10-mm corneal volume and HEX% blocks
exclusions.reason: p-values are not admissible; not endothelial cell density

notes: Role: two standard phacoemulsification techniques compared without an investigational agent or device; both control-role, separate groups.
Seven patients had one eye in each group.
Licence statement names the Creative Commons Attribution License without a version or URL; it grants unrestricted use with attribution, so it is treated as CC BY (public).
Same institution and surgeon as ecd-pmc6157994, with a different enrolment period (September 2017 to May 2018 here). The specular microscope model is not named in this article.

series.baseline_label: Pre-op (Table 4, ECD (mm2) block) = preoperative central ECD of the operated eye
series.notes: Table 4 'Steep-axis one-handed' column, rows Pre-op, 1 week, 1 month and 3 month post-op under 'ECD (mm2)' (read as cells/mm2; central endothelial cell measurements per Methods 2.4); 1 week = 7/30.4375 months. Per-visit n not tabulated.

series.notes: Table 4 'Steep-axis two-handed' column, rows Pre-op, 1 week, 1 month and 3 month post-op under 'ECD (mm2)' (read as cells/mm2); 1 week = 7/30.4375 months. Per-visit n not tabulated.
